title: Singing That's My Home and others stealing his material
summary: Punch sings That's My Home and says another musician stole many of his songs, though he recorded this one himself.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
